[IDÉZETT POSZT, amelyet Elon Musk megosztott. Eredeti szerzője: DogeDesigner (@cb_doge); megjelent: 2026-11-14T16:37:28+00:00; link: https://x.com/cb_doge/status/2121643690913644780; média: videó, 15 másodperc]
BREAKING: SpaceX donates @Starlink kits to help vulnerable children. Lagos State’s Ministry of Youth and Social Development received Starlink devices to improve care services via BEB Global.

SpaceX’s wider grant covers 750 kits in 16 countries and 12 months of free internet.
